blogs.title: Essential Newborn Care Tips Every Parent Should Know
blogs.author: Dr. Vijay Yadav
blogs.excerpt: Welcoming a baby brings endless joy and questions. Learn crucial guidance from Dr. Vijay Yadav on newborn care, thermal regulation, feeding, and hygiene.
blogs.content: Bringing home a newborn child is one of life's most precious milestones, but it can also be intimidating. Temperature control is critical: infants under one month are sensitive to heat loss. Always keep your baby comfortably wrapped in soft cotton layers. Exclusive breastfeeding for the first six months provides essential antibodies for immunity against infections. Ensure cord care remains clean and dry. Watch for red flags like sluggish feeding, persistent fever above 100.4°F, or yellowing skin (jaundice) and consult Nova Medicare Hospital's 24x7 emergency pediatric hotline immediately.

blogs.title: Complete Childhood Vaccination Schedule Guide (2026)
blogs.author: Nova Medicare Pediatric Team
blogs.excerpt: Immunization is the safest way to protect your child against preventable diseases. Here is Nova Medicare Hospital's complete recommended vaccination timeline.
blogs.content: Vaccines stimulate your baby's immune system without causing disease, building vital defenses against polio, tuberculosis, hepatitis B, rotavirus, measles, and pneumococcal infections. At birth, newborns receive BCG, OPV dose 0, and Hep-B1. At 6, 10, and 14 weeks, essential combination vaccines provide multi-spectrum protection. Don't skip annual flu shots or booster doses at 18 months and 5 years. Nova Medicare Hospital operates a dedicated painless vaccination clinic in Agra with strict cold-chain preservation.

blogs.title: Understanding NICU & PICU: When Does Your Child Need Critical Care?
blogs.author: Dr. Vijay Yadav
blogs.excerpt: Demystifying Neonatal (NICU) and Pediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU). How advanced monitoring saves little lives.
blogs.content: When a baby is born prematurely, with low birth weight, or experiences acute respiratory distress, the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) provides specialized incubator environment, mechanical ventilation, radiant warmers, and 24x7 monitoring by trained neonatologists. PICU supports toddlers and older children facing severe asthma attacks, high-grade seizures, trauma, or post-surgical recovery. Nova Medicare Hospital features state-of-the-art Level-III NICU & PICU facilities in Agra staffed 24 hours a day.

blogs.title: Nutrition & Growth Milestones: 6 Months to 5 Years
blogs.author: Child Nutrition Department
blogs.excerpt: Transitioning from milk to solid weaning foods. Healthy recipes, micronutrient requirements, and weight milestone checks.
blogs.content: At 6 months, complementary feeding should begin alongside breast milk. Introduce single-ingredient mashes like mashed banana, boiled ragi porridge, or apple puree. Avoid adding salt or sugar before age one. Ensure balanced iron, zinc, and vitamin D intake for healthy cognitive and skeletal development.
